svg.title: Hi, I'm Daniyal.
svg.desc: Hi, I'm Daniyal. Math / BBA @ Waterloo & Laurier. Building Covalent.. GTM Engineer @ Slashy (YC S25). Animated: two stick-figure wizards duel beneath the text with red and green spells. The red wizard loses a beam clash and is knocked out, gets back up, turns Super Saiyan, and blasts his rival with a giant blue Kamehameha that leaves a tiny skeleton, then dust. He tries to fix a knocked-out letter, another one falls on his head, and he runs off as the page repairs itself.
